observations: Photo 0 shows a brown cardboard box with 'Nikon D750' printed in large black letters, with a yellow Nikon logo sticker on the side. The box is taped and partially open. In the background, there is a white box with a camera image and a 'NIKKOR LENS 50' box.

Photo 1 shows the same Nikon D750 box open, revealing two manuals: 'Nikon D750 Digital Camera User Manual' and 'Nikon D750 Digital Camera Manual'. The manuals are wrapped in plastic. The box is placed on a white box with a red sticker and barcode.

Photo 2 shows the interior of the same box with bubble wrap containing two dark, cylindrical objects wrapped in plastic. One object has a white label with 'D750' visible. The box is open and appears to be new or lightly used.

claims.claim: American used Nikon D750 Body, clean and pure as new, working perfectly.
claims.evidence: The box and manuals are present, but there is no visible proof of the camera being functional or that it is from an American source. The 'clean and pure as new' claim cannot be verified from the photos alone.

risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: The camera may have been tampered with or have a non-original lens or accessories included.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the camera body showing the serial number and a photo of the lens and other accessories included.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing accessories or non-original

risks.risk: The camera may have been used in a harsh environment or have moisture damage.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera body with the lens removed, showing the sensor and internal components.
